summary.text: Carlie Kotyza-Witthuhn is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 49B and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026, against Republican Wendy Cregg. She co-chairs the Children and Families Finance and Policy Committee.

paragraphs.text: Carlie Kotyza-Witthuhn grew up in Sheboygan, Wisconsin, and lives in Eden Prairie, Minnesota.
She earned a B.A. in entrepreneurship and Spanish from the University of St. Thomas in 2008.

Ballotpedia says her career includes work as a sales and operations analyst at Daugherty Business Solutions, interim manager of volunteer services at the Minnesota Landscape Arboretum, and work at Make-A-Wish of Minnesota.
Kotyza-Witthuhn defeated incumbent Jenifer Loon in the November 6, 2018, general election for District 48B, and defeated Wendi Russo in District 49B on November 5, 2024.
For 2025-2026 she is co-chair of the Children and Families Finance and Policy Committee and serves on the Commerce Finance and Policy and Ways and Means committees.
